facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: loss of containment at SG-4100 during an intrusive maintenance task

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on SG-4100 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. SG-4100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 26 September 2023 an incident occurred on SG-4100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
